mapper.select: SELECT SEAT_ID , SEAT_NUMBER , STATUS , CREATED_TIME , UPDATED_TIME , SEAT_ROW , SEAT_COL FROM seat
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( ORDER_ID , SEAT_ID , RESERVE_DATE , START_TIME , END_TIME , STATUS , CREATED_TIME , UPDATED_TIME , IS_USED) VALUES ( #{orderId} , #{seatId} , NOW() , NOW() , NOW() + INTERVAL #{reserveTime} HOUR , 'TEMP' , NOW() , NOW() , 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT SEAT_NUMBER , STATUS FROM seat WHERE SEAT_ID = #{seatId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT S.SEAT_ID FROM reservation R INNER JOIN seat S ON R.SEAT_ID = S.SEAT_ID WHERE NOW() > R.END_TIME AND R.STATUS IN ('TEMP', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET STATUS = 'EXPIRED' , UPDATED_TIME = NOW() WHERE SEAT_ID = #{seatId} AND NOW() > END_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT SEAT_ID FROM reservation WHERE STATUS = 'TEMP' AND NOW() > CREATED_TIME + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
